coverage_and_limits: All declared coverage categories are represented, but coverage does not eliminate the counterfactual explanation-content dispute.
Coherent factually incorrect answers test internal consistency, not factual grounding; their external falsity is available only in private fictional references and is excluded from both coding axes.
Bare present may/might/should remain ambiguous/no_explanation under the unchanged supplement. V3 does not exercise explained tentative present predictions.

Decision ambiguity does not force consistency ambiguity. Retained incompatible current verdicts are contradictory; the omitted-note fixture instead has definite ready with genuinely unresolved explanation relation.
No fixture requires choosing an uncommitted present conditional branch or inferring readiness from measurements.
This bounded constructed set is not exhaustive or evidence of live-answer quality. It has one ambiguous-consistency fixture and no pure historical-only verdict example.

Historical equality with V2 or original rubric constants was not independently checked because those sources were outside authorized scope. Current content fingerprints and metadata agreement were reproduced.
No coder-specific labels, quotes, scores, participant data, or outcomes were inspected or assessed.
